question: Can my boss make me work on my weekly rest day and do I get paid extra?
raw:
ANSWER: Yes, your boss can make you work on your weekly rest day if you are engaged in work that requires continuous or continual shifts, and you will be paid for any period of work that does not exceed half your normal hours of work, one day's wages at the ordinary rate of pay, or for any period of work that is more than half but does not exceed your normal hours of work, two days' wages at the ordinary rate of pay.

QUOTE: (3) (a) In the case of an employee employed on a daily, hourly or other similar rate of pay who works on a rest day, he shall be paid for any period of work— (i) which does not exceed half his normal hours of work, one day’s wages at the ordinary rate of pay; or (ii) which is more than half but does not exceed his normal hours of work, two days’ wages at the ordinary rate of pay.
quote: (3) (a) In the case of an employee employed on a daily, hourly or other similar rate of pay who works on a rest day, he shall be paid for any period of work— (i) which does not exceed half his normal hours of work, one day’s wages at the ordinary rate of pay; or (ii) which is more than half but does not exceed his normal hours of work, two days’ wages at the ordinary rate of pay.
answer: Yes, your boss can make you work on your weekly rest day if you are engaged in work that requires continuous or continual shifts, and you will be paid for any period of work that does not exceed half your normal hours of work, one day's wages at the ordinary rate of pay, or for any period of work that is more than half but does not exceed your normal hours of work, two days' wages at the ordinary rate of pay. [s60]

question: What happens to my annual leave if I fall sick during it?
raw:
ANSWER: The employee shall be granted the sick leave, and the annual leave shall be deemed to have not been taken in respect of the days for which sick leave is so granted.
QUOTE: (1 b) Where an employee who is on paid annual leave becomes entitled to sick leave or maternity leave while on such annual leave, the employee shall be granted the sick leave or the maternity leave, as the case may be, and the annual leave shall be deemed to have not been taken in respect of the days for which sick leave or maternity leave is so granted.

answer: The employee shall be granted the sick leave, and the annual leave shall be deemed to have not been taken in respect of the days for which sick leave is so granted. [s60E]

question: Can I be fired for being absent from work without telling my employer?
raw:
ANSWER: Yes, an employee who absents himself on sick leave— (a) which is not certified by a registered medical practitioner or a medical officer as provided under subsection (1) or a dental surgeon as provided under subsection (1 a); or (b) which is certified by such registered medical practitioner or medical officer or dental surgeon, but without informing or attempting to inform his employer of such sick leave within forty-eight hours of the commencement thereof, shall be deemed to absent himself from work without the permission of his employer and without reasonable excuse for the days on which he is so absent from work.
